results.content:
Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for developers and companies building products, workflows, and agents around people. We've built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, giving developers one API to search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities, and retrieve up-to-date information from across the web. Unlike traditional people databases built around static records, Ploid combines its massive people index with real-time retrieval and identity resolution, delivering fresh, reliable information whenever it's needed. From sales and recruiting to customer intelligence, trust and safety, and AI agents, Ploid replaces fragmented data providers with a single infrastructure layer. 2B+ people. One API. Built for AI. Why did we built this? We noticed the same problem everywhere: people's data was either outdated, scattered across the internet, too expensive, or incredibly difficult to access. This made it hard for companies to build great products and deliver accurate results to their customers. What stood out to us was that almost every data provider was building for humans, especially sales and GTM teams, but almost no one was building for AI agents. We believe agents are the future, and they need reliable, up-to-date information about people to actually do their jobs well.

Unlike traditional data providers that rely on static databases and limited professional profiles, Ploid continuously indexes and enriches information from across the public web to build a dynamic understanding of more than 2 billion people. By combining large-scale data collection with advanced AI reasoning, Ploid enables sales, recruiting, investment, and business development teams to discover ideal prospects, uncover meaningful insights, and personalize outreach in seconds.
